objective: Determine whether public-history adaptation survives model uncertainty and nonstationarity beyond the known noiseless fixture, before attributing gains to a learned VLA.
required_predecessor: Same information and candidate-set comparison in the separately frozen episode-two checkpoint; preserve its denominator and failures.

stages.question: Can a controller preserve original references when a previously dropped command becomes effective?
stages.protocol: Freeze both forward and reverse transitions and charged diagnosis before execution. No true fault label in actor input. Independently reconstruct original reference and effect events.
stages.acceptance: Report every transition, repairs and harms, initial cost and recovery attempts. A lower harm count alone is insufficient if achievable stable cases are lost. Do not reinterpret altered reference events as original success.

stages.question: Is there a residual decision problem after complete deterministic candidates under uncertain sensing, service and dynamics?
held_out_axes: response families not fitted exactly by the eight-pair model
fault mechanisms outside the three-class support
continuous process advancement during planner work
stages.acceptance: Use frozen task instances, model calibration and uncertainty coverage separated from evaluation. Record capture, delivery, compute and physical effect clocks; wall-clock latency is charged. Report FALSE and UNKNOWN rather than collapsing them.

stages.question: Does one shared policy improve beyond rules and retain verified recovery experience?
stages.implementation: Shared history/contract-conditioned diffusion policy followed by student-state expert relabeling and matched DAgger. Use one common harness and identical teacher budget. Offline/online RL or multi-expert distribution distillation require an independently demonstrated remaining bottleneck.
factorial_controls: engineering configuration K frozen or updated
stages.acceptance: Actually train weights, then disable the online teacher and measure with and without memory. Compare first, second, third, fifth and tenth attempts plus all-attempt cumulative utility. Do not call finite fault inference neural ICL or parameter learning.

stages.question: Does the complete system meet independently measured physical and chemical contracts?
required_evidence: real robot RGB and control logs
independent chemical endpoint and batch records
stages.status: MAJOR_OPEN; local simulated mechanics and recorded RGB do not satisfy this gate

promotion_rule: Do not start a resource-intensive learned comparison merely to reproduce a known exact-model control solution. Freeze concrete task feasibility, strong controls and independent scoring first.
